theme.title: Rotation: Growth → Value & Defensives
theme.summary: Energy (+0.56%) and Financials (+0.53%) led the market today, while Technology (-1.85%) and Consumer Discretionary (-0.74%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -0.95% versus -0.09% for defensives and +0.08% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.61%, Dow -0.41%, Nasdaq -1.09% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.87%. The VIX rose 1.15% to 20.15, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 2.17% to $4,035.30, crude oil was little changed at $86.06, and bitcoin slipped 2.61% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
